lines.en: I swim past the mossy rocks, tail working.
I move slowly underwater.

lines.zh: 我啃着石上的苔，一路往前。
lines.en: I graze the moss on the stones as I go.
I loop around the waterweeds.
I swim toward the moss.
Two flicks of my tail and I change course.

lines.zh: 没有下巴，我也能挤过窄缝。
lines.en: Without a jaw, I still squeeze through narrow gaps.

lines.zh: 浅水的石头滑，我慢点游。
lines.en: The shallows are slippery; I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着水面下一点点游。
lines.en: I swim just below the surface.
I jerk forward in little pulses.
I hug the silty bottom and search.
I swim beneath a clump of weeds.
I swim slowly toward your feet.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下石头，又绕开。
lines.en: I bump a stone and go around it.
My tail beats without much force.

lines.zh: 我游过一个洞口，又退回来。
lines.en: I swim past a hole and back again.
I sink and settle on the silt.

lines.zh: 我朝上面的光游了一段。
lines.en: I swim a stretch toward the light above.
I hang in the water, tail barely moving.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，一下一下吸水。
lines.en: I open my mouth and draw water in pulses.
I cling to a stone without moving.
My mouth has no lower jaw.

lines.zh: 我在啃一块长苔的石头。
lines.en: I am nibbling a mossy stone.
I stop among the waterweeds.

lines.zh: 我顺着水，慢慢掉了个头。
lines.en: I drift with the water and slowly turn.

lines.zh: 我张着圆嘴，让苔屑随水进鳃。
lines.en: My round mouth hangs open, moss bits flowing to my gills.
Being underwater suits me best.
I bury my head in the silt.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，颜色很淡。
lines.en: My body is soft and pale.
I make no noise and no movement.

lines.zh: 水面上的光照下来，很好。
lines.en: The light from above is pleasant.
I wait for the current to bring something.

lines.zh: 你站在水里，腿就在我旁边。
lines.en: You stand in the water, your leg beside me.
I have no teeth, and I am fierce.
My mouth is round and holds fast.
The moss by your feet; I want it.

lines.zh: 我没有下巴，也能绕着你转。
lines.en: No jaw, and still I circle you.
Do not step on me; I am soft.
I lift my head to look at you, with effort.

lines.zh: 你脚上的泥，是岸上的泥。
lines.en: The mud on your feet is from the shore.
I press against your boot.
You stand out in this water.
I lie crooked a moment to recover.
The swat drives me into the mud.

lines.zh: 我摆了两下尾，躲到石头后。
lines.en: I beat my tail twice and hide behind a stone.
My gill covers flap fast.

lines.zh: 血涌进鳃里，我吐了串泡。
lines.en: Blood floods my gills; I blow a string of bubbles.
The wound hardly shows in water.
I swim a little away.
I dip head-down and recover.
I have no teeth, but I struggle.
I slide out from under your hand.
Leave that moss; it is mine.
Put the stone down.
There is something I want under the water.
You scuffed the moss free; good.
You stir the water; I do not like it.
Moss is growing there; I see it.
You move and the moss drifts to me.
Has moss grown on your boots?
I press toward the ground under your feet.
There is a taste in the water; I follow it.
You bump me and I slide away.
No jaw, but I still ram.

lines.zh: 水流一推，我贴住你的腿。
lines.en: The current pushes me against your leg.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我肚皮朝上又翻回。
lines.en: You bump me; I flip belly-up and back.
You step on me and I burrow into the mud.
We knock and the bubbles scatter.
I am shoved into a stone.
I swim out between your feet.
I bumped you out of curiosity.

lines.zh: 分开之后，我还在你旁边。
lines.en: After we part, I am still beside you.
There is another one in the water.
We cling side by side to a stone.
I beat my tail and drift toward it.
Our mouths meet.
There is a small shoal in the weeds.
No jaw, and I still graze moss.

lines.zh: 没有下巴，啃苔藓也一样。
lines.en: No jaw, but moss still gets eaten.
It is jawless, like me.
We crowd into the rock gap.

lines.zh: 两条无颌的身子，顺着水贴住。
lines.en: Two jawless bodies press together with the current.
I suck the moss down in one go.
I scrape it up with my mouth.
The moss on this stone is mine.
I cannot bite; I can only suck.
I roll it into my mouth.
This is too small to fill me.
I tuck this soft moss into a stone crack.
Whatever falls in the water, I try.
Two sucks and I am satisfied.
I rub it loose slowly.
I have fixed on that moss.
I swim toward your feet.

lines.zh: 你踩着的石头上长苔了。
lines.en: The stone you stand on has moss.
I have chosen this direction.
I flick my tail and aim.
You are in my path; move.
The most moss is here; I stay.

lines.zh: 苔藓的腥味，从那边飘来。
lines.en: The mossy smell drifts from over there.
I've no jaw, but I can still gnaw.
I like that spot.
I keep along your foot.
Each step you take, I come an inch nearer.
No hurry; the water will carry me.
You move your foot and the moss shows.
I circle that stone.
My mouth opens and closes, testing.
Wherever you go, the water settles there.

lines.zh: 我没有下颌，可我很执着。
lines.en: I have no jaw, but I am persistent.
I follow along the silty bottom.
You have not noticed I am here.
I suck onto your ankle and hold.
I gnaw your hand with my round mouth.
No teeth in it, but it numbs.
I butt your shin.

lines.zh: 我扒住你的靴子往上蹭。
lines.en: I cling to your boot and work upward.
The suction makes you shake your hand.
What I bite is really the moss on you.
That one cost me more than it should.
I suck twice and let go.
You pull onto the bank and I cannot follow.
A shape appears under the surface.

lines.zh: 我啃着苔藓，嘴一圈圈吸。
lines.en: I gnaw the moss, my mouth sucking in circles.
I touch your boot first.
A ring of bubbles rises, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从水草里游出来。
lines.en: I swim slowly out of the weeds.
The water by the steps stirs.
I land and settle into the sand.
The surface makes a small sound.

lines.zh: 河底的苔一动，我钻了出来。
lines.en: The bottom moss stirs; I slip out.
I edge closer to the bank.
My colour is much like the water.
I stop beneath your feet.
A wash of hot water sends me darting away.

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛上来，摔在岸上。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water onto the bank.

lines.zh: 水里也会淹，我拼命摆尾。
lines.en: Even in water I can drown; I beat my tail wildly.
The blast fills the bottom with sand.
The arrow enters the water and veers off.
Magic hits and I freeze in the water.

lines.zh: 苔被我啃完了，我很虚弱。
lines.en: I have eaten all the moss, and I am weak.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning reaches into the water and I convulse.
The void pulls and the water cannot hold me.
